description: This script manages DHCP switch operations including scheduling and executing network maintenance tasks, modifying cron jobs, and controlling services based on system states and input commands.

methods.name: calcExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a randomized execution time within a specified maintenance window, adjusting for system time offsets and ensuring the schedule is within a 24-hour limit.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules a cron job to run the dhcpswitch.sh script at a randomized time based on maintenance window calculations.

methods.name: RemoveCron
methods.description: Removes existing dhcpswitch.sh cron jobs from the system's crontab.

methods.name: wait_till_state_wan_stopped
methods.description: Waits until the WAN connection status is 'stopped', polling up to 9 times with 1 second intervals.

methods.name: wait_till_state_wan_started
methods.description: Waits until the WAN connection status is 'started', polling every second.
